title: Sweep de higiene docs+codigo: HELP, comentarios stale, ADR banners, sentinels, README
description: Bundle de correcoes pequenas da auditoria 2026-07-08, nenhuma muda comportamento: (1) HELP do binario: index.ts:91 diz cam next launches loop as tmux pane (real: sinal active:true, sem pane; README ja correto) e index.ts:93 anuncia plan [--issue N] (flag inexistente; e posicional, PLAN_HELP index.ts:231 correto). (2) src/version.ts:12-14 comenta parity-test de package.json que nao existe (package.json ja tem version 0.93.0; test/version.test.ts nao referencia; adicionar assert de paridade ou corrigir comentario; runbook r.4 manda editar os dois sem nada pegar drift). (3) merge-watch.ts:288 comenta cam-ship.md Step 7 extinto (real: runShipPrStep). (4) result.ts:398 branch morto parseando CAM_REVIEWER_STATUS que nenhum prompt emite. (5) ADRs sem banner de supersessao: 0004 (active:true -> setPhase, superseded por 0006), 0006 (BLOCK auto-re-plana ate 2x via ADR-0012; shipping phase em uso via 0009/0013), 0008 (callsite movido pro runSidecarLoop, ADR-0013). (6) cam-plan.md:12 exemplo CAM-151.json sem padding (real: CAM-0151.json; contradiz o proprio N-padded da linha). (7) cam-spec.md: sentinel de sucesso CAM_DOMAIN_DOCS_WRITTEN=<id> sha= (spec.ts:318) nao documentado; reason missing-main (issue-specify.ts:106) fora da tabela de erro. (8) README command table sem tag, drain, journal, review, ship (todos no HELP do binario). (9) scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md stop-condition silente sobre CLEAN poder carregar SUGGESTIONs auto-filadas (CAM-189). (10) subagent-implementer.md:192 PRD_COMPLETE row diz orchestrator should run /cam-review (real: sidecar decide via decideNextAction). (11) cam-review.md:43-84 secao Gather context + Task() morta (~2.6KB; reviewer e spawnado pelo sidecar via buildReviewerWorkerArgv). Origem: auditorias 2026-07-08.

spec.scope: Hygiene sweep of 11 small no-behavior-change corrections from the 2026-07-08 audits (docs, stale comments, dead code/doc, ADR banners, sentinels, README, plus one parity test). Files: src/index.ts (HELP), src/version.ts + test/version.test.ts (parity assert), src/release/merge-watch.ts (stale comment), src/supervisor/result.ts (dead CAM_REVIEWER_STATUS branch removal), docs/adr/0004,0006,0008 (supersession banners), .claude/commands/cam-plan.md, .claude/commands/cam-spec.md, .claude/agents/subagent-implementer.md, .claude/commands/cam-review.md (dead Task() section removal ~2.6KB), scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md (stop-condition note), README.md (command table) — templated files in BOTH copies + re-embed src/vendor/_generated.ts via `bun run embed-vendor`. Out of scope: any behavior change; the anti-drift guard (CAM-61).
acceptanceCriteria: index.ts HELP no longer says `cam next` launches a loop as a tmux pane (real: flips active:true, no pane) and no longer advertises `plan [--issue N]` (the flag does not exist; issue id is positional, matching PLAN_HELP).

src/version.ts comment no longer references a non-existent package.json parity test; a real parity assertion is added (test that package.json version equals src/version.ts) so version drift is caught (runbook r.4 gap closed).
merge-watch.ts:288 no longer references the extinct cam-ship.md Step 7 (real: runShipPrStep); the dead CAM_REVIEWER_STATUS parsing branch in result.ts:398 (emitted by no prompt) is removed.

docs/adr/0004, 0006, and 0008 carry accurate supersession/status banners (0004 superseded by 0006; 0006 notes BLOCK auto-re-plan via ADR-0012 and shipping phase via 0009/0013; 0008 notes callsite moved to runSidecarLoop per ADR-0013).
cam-plan.md example uses the padded CAM-0151.json (not CAM-151.json); cam-spec.md documents the CAM_DOMAIN_DOCS_WRITTEN=<id> sha= success sentinel and adds the missing-main reason to its error table.

README command table includes tag, drain, journal, review, and ship; scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md stop-condition notes that a CLEAN verdict may carry auto-filed SUGGESTIONs (CAM-189); subagent-implementer.md PRD_COMPLETE row says the sidecar decides the next action via decideNextAction (not that the orchestrator should run /cam-review); the dead 'Gather context + Task()' section in cam-review.md (:43-84) is removed.
All templated edits are applied to both copies and re-embedded; `bun run embed-vendor:check`, `bun run typecheck`, `bun test` (incl. the new parity assert), and vendor/check are green.
gotchas: Every item is no-behavior-change EXCEPT the added version parity test (a new test) and two dead-removals (result.ts branch, cam-review.md section) — both audit-authorized, not speculative cleanup.
docs/adr/ is repo-root domain model, NOT templated: ADR banner edits require no re-embed. cam-plan/cam-spec/cam-review/subagent-implementer/scripts-CLAUDE ARE templated: both copies + re-embed.

This sweep touches files shared with other batch issues: scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md (CAM-224/226/231/232), subagent-implementer.md (CAM-229/231), cam-plan.md (CAM-230). blockedBy [CAM-232, CAM-230] places it last so it reconciles against their edits (CAM-232's ancestry covers 224/226/231/229).

The reviewer is spawned by the sidecar via buildReviewerWorkerArgv (Task()-in-context section in cam-review.md is dead); the implementer PRD_COMPLETE path is resolved by decideNextAction, not an orchestrator /cam-review call.
